evidence_quotes: Furthermore, Chunghwa Telecom needed a platform with robust security controls.
To improve artificial intelligence (AI) data security and governance, the company migrated its generative AI projects to AWS.
Chunghwa Telecom has been working with Amazon Web Services (AWS) for several years and chose to build and scale new generative AI solutions.

Jason Lin, vice president of information technology group at Chunghwa Telecom, explains, “The scope and scale of our engagement with AWS has increased, mainly because AWS has an incredibly secure cloud infrastructure, enhancing the speed and agility of security automation.” Amazon Bedrock offers several capabilities to support Chunghwa Telecom’s security and privacy requirements.

The service has achieved Health Insurance Portability and Accountability Act (HIPAA) eligibility and General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR) compliance—both important for the telco’s international partnerships.
Additionally, Chunghwa Telecom values how Amazon Bedrock neither monitors or reviews content, nor uses it to improve the base models, nor shares content with third-party model providers.
